hero.title:
Explore any song
with AI precision
hero.description: Upload your audio files. StemTube separates stems, detects chords, syncs lyrics, and gives you a full mixer — ready to practice, learn, or create.
features.label: Features
features.title: What StemTube can do
features.subtitle: Core audio analysis features running locally on your machine. Some features are still experimental — your feedback shapes the roadmap.
feature.stems.title: AI Stem Separation
feature.stems.desc: Split any song into vocals, bass, drums, guitar, piano and more using Demucs. Choose between 4-stem and 6-stem models for the level of detail you need.
feature.chords.title: Chord Detection
feature.chords.desc: Hybrid BTC Transformer + madmom CRF pipeline detecting 170 chord types. Real-time chord display with guitar diagrams synchronized to playback.
feature.lyrics.title: Synchronized Lyrics
feature.lyrics.desc: Synced lyrics from Musixmatch with fallback to Whisper AI transcription. Word-level timestamps with karaoke-style highlighting and a dedicated Focus mode.
feature.mixer.title: Full Mixer
feature.mixer.desc: Per-stem volume, pan, mute and solo controls. Tempo adjustment with pitch correction via SoundTouch. Waveform visualization with playhead scrubbing.
feature.recording.title: Recording Studio Experimental
feature.recording.desc: Record your instrument or vocals over the stems with latency compensation and de-bleed via Demucs. This feature is still evolving — feedback and contributions welcome.
feature.jam.title: Jam Sessions Experimental
feature.jam.desc: Collaborative jam rooms via WebSocket with shared BPM and synchronized playback. Guest access with auto-generated names, no account required. Still in active development.
feature.mobile.title: Mobile PWA
feature.mobile.desc: Progressive web app for iOS and Android. Touch-optimized mixer, recording, chord display and lyrics — same core features as desktop.
feature.themes.title: Themes
feature.themes.desc: Multiple visual themes including neumorphic and cyberpunk modes. Design is not our strongest suit — if you have UI/UX skills, we'd love your help.
feature.selfhosted.title: Self-Hosted
feature.selfhosted.desc: Runs on your own hardware. GPU-accelerated with CUDA auto-detection, automatic CPU fallback. Your data stays on your machine.
howItWorks.label: How It Works
howItWorks.title: From audio file to full mixer in minutes
step1.title: Upload a File
step1.desc: Drop any MP3, WAV, FLAC or other audio format. StemTube checks for existing extractions to avoid duplicate processing.
step2.title: AI Analysis
step2.desc: Demucs separates stems. BTC + madmom detect chords. Musixmatch or Whisper fetch lyrics. All in parallel.
step3.title: Mix & Practice
step3.desc: Open the full mixer. Mute the guitar and play along with chords displayed in real-time. Adjust tempo without changing pitch.
step4.title: Record & Jam
step4.desc: Record your take over the stems. Invite friends to a jam session room. Share synchronized playback in real-time.

tech.label: Tech Stack
tech.title: Built with proven open-source tools
contribute.label: Contribute
contribute.title: This project needs you
contribute.motto: Alone I went fast, together you'll go further.
contribute.desc: StemTube is delivered as a fully functional solution. However, my professional and personal commitments don't allow me to take it further alone. This is where you come in:
contribute.item1: UI/UX Design — the current interface is functional but minimal. If you have design skills, your input would make a real difference.
contribute.item2: Frontend Development — help improve the mobile experience, add polish to the mixer and interactions.
contribute.item3: Testing & Bug Reports — try it on different hardware and browsers, report issues, suggest improvements.
contribute.item4: Translations — help make StemTube accessible in more languages.
story.label: About
story.title: A vibe coding experiment turned open-source project
story.p1: StemTube started as an experiment in vibe coding — exploring what happens when you let AI-assisted development guide the creative process without rigid planning.
story.p2: What began as a weekend hack turned into a growing music workstation. The project kept evolving because the problems were genuinely fun to solve: how do you synchronize chord detection with waveform scrubbing? How do you compensate for recording latency across different browsers?
story.quote: After 25 years in IT, I wanted to give back to the open-source ecosystem that gave me so much throughout my career. StemTube is that contribution — imperfect, evolving, and open to all.
story.p3: The entire codebase is open, from the AI pipeline to the PWA frontend. No tracking, no accounts required for basic use, no cloud dependency. Your music, your machine.
cta.title: Want to try it?
cta.desc: Clone the repo, run the setup script, and you're up in minutes. Feedback and contributions welcome.
disclaimer.title: Responsible Use
disclaimer.text: StemTube is a tool for learning, practicing, and creating music. It is not intended to facilitate piracy or harm artists' rights. Each user is solely responsible for their use of this software in accordance with the laws of their country. Please respect the artists whose music you enjoy.
